newsitem.title: SPAIN: Huelva smelter to up 1998 output to 300,000 tns/yr.
newsitem.headline: Huelva smelter to up 1998 output to 300,000 tns/yr.

text.p: Atlantic Copper Holding SA is to increase production at its Huelva smelter to 300,000 tonnes per year in 1998 after updating facilities next month, a spokesman for the company said on Monday.

"There'll be a stoppage for just under two weeks around the end of May, after which we will have increased production by around 30,000 tonnes per year from 270,000 previously," the spokesman told Reuters.
However production would not be raised noticeably until 1998, he said.

"In 1997 the increased capacity will compensate for the stoppage, so we won't see the full extent of the improvement until next year. This year we'll produce between 270,000-300,000 tonnes and next year we'll reach 300,000 tonnes," he said.
